_doc: Optional network guard (mmcoding/host/guard.py, guard_addon.py). Copy to configs/guard.json or set RV_GUARD_CONFIG. Paths: $VARS and ~ are expanded, relative paths are relative to the repository root.
_service: systemd unit running the proxy (checked before every case); null = only check that the port accepts connections
_registry: per-container entries written by guard.py and read by guard_addon.py
_nss_debs: Ubuntu 22.04 packages providing certutil for images without it (unpacked privately, never installed); file name -> sha256
_task_allow: optional JSON {"tasks": {task_id: [url fragment, ...]}} of task input URLs that the rules would otherwise block (see guard_addon.py)
_passthrough_hosts: host names (and their subdomains) whose TLS is never intercepted, e.g. the model endpoint
_direct_cidrs: destination ranges besides the private ranges that bypass the proxy
